notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Bugs:
- Fixed random Egghead Gumpty jumpscare.
- Fixed some furniture not moving when touching player.
- Fixed Egghead Gumpty appearing out of range in some circumstances.

Adjustments:
- More overall balance.
- Egghead Gumpty appears more commonly.
- Presents appear more often.

---------------
Please report any bugs to us at euphoricbrosgames@gmail.com or DM Faris on Twitter
Thanks and enjoy the game :)
